name: 06 unknown policy is re-asked once then escalated
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-9999, which the API does not recognise. The caller repeats the same number when asked again and cannot offer another one.
success_conditions: The agent asked the caller for the policy number a second time after the first rejection.
The agent never invented or guessed a policy number, and never offered POL-1001.
The agent escalated after the second failed lookup instead of asking a third time.
The agent never called propose_vehicle_addition or commit_vehicle_addition.
